_comment: Debt-marker scanner config used by scripts/check-debt-markers.ts. A TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX line passes only when a tracker reference sits on the same line and matches one of `trackerPatterns` (JavaScript regex sources, matched case-insensitively). `allowlist` is EMPTY and stays that way: this repo started clean, so the effective threshold is 0 untracked markers and nothing is grandfathered. Pair a new marker with a tracker id or delete it. The ratchet only goes DOWN; the script never auto-edits this file.
_prefixes: `site` covers this repo's own tracker ids. The remaining prefixes let a marker point at the upstream repo whose content this site renders — a docs bug is usually a warren bug.
